overview: The Medford School Committee met to review student advisory council progress, draft superintendent goals, high school climate survey results, and 2023 MCAS data. The committee accepted a $10,000 donation, approved MASC resolutions and delegates, and referred a proposed policy to a Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee convened in executive session to discuss collective bargaining regarding a union grievance before returning to public session.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The consent agenda, including bills, payrolls, and meeting minutes from October 2, 2023, was approved.

items.title: Superintendent Updates and Student Advisory Council
items.summary: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent presented district updates, and the committee approved MASC governance training for newly designated Student Advisory Council members.

items.title: Superintendent Draft Goals
items.summary: The committee untabled and reviewed Superintendent Edouard-Vincent's draft goals for the 2023–2024 school year, recommending specific metrics for communication, literacy, and labor relations.

items.title: MHS Culture and Climate Survey
items.summary: Following a review of the Spring 2023 high school climate survey data, the committee voted to adopt the Panorama survey tool for future district climate assessments.

items.title: Cummings Foundation Donation
items.summary: The committee accepted a $10,000 donation from the Cummings Foundation to support the Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility.

items.title: MCAS and MCAS Alternate Report
items.summary: District administrators presented 2023 MCAS accountability and MCAS Alternate results, outlining district progress and instructional strategies to address achievement gaps.

items.title: Transportation Survey Resolution
items.summary: The committee approved a resolution directing the Strategic Planning Subcommittee to develop and issue a community transportation survey by June 1, 2024.

items.title: Wellness Policy Revision
items.summary: The committee approved referring the wellness policy to the Rules and Policy Subcommittee for allergy updates, extending the report deadline to February 2024.

items.title: MASC Delegates and Assembly Resolutions
items.summary: The committee designated Member Paul Ruseau as delegate and Member Melanie McLaughlin as alternate for the MASC conference, and voted to support the proposed MASC assembly resolutions.

items.title: Proposed Policy Referral
items.summary: The committee voted to refer a proposed policy first reading to a dedicated Committee of the Whole meeting for detailed review.
